verdict.rationale: Apify publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at docs.apify.com/api/openapi.json and an API v2 reference (e.g., the webhooks endpoint page). Its client docs include copy-pasteable code examples for running Actors and retrieving results. Nothing in the pack shows the reference is interactive (try-it console, in-browser execution) or that the examples are runnable in place. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it API explorer, runnable in-browser examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
